name: Saotome Yuuta
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives with his parents, grandpa, and dog.
A kid who was born into showbiz, his father is an influential figure and his mother is a former Takarazuka actress.
He lives in a giant mansion and commutes to a private middle school.
However his mother doesn't want him to become a celebrity.
He's usually a serious and honest kid, but he has a selfish side. An only child.
